external_runtime_and_dependency_limits.detail: No audit of serde/serde_core/derive, indexmap, zmij, IDNA, encoding, RNG or any downstream dependency closure.
Declarations and conditional/default/optional feature edges only; no Cargo resolution, selected target, build invocation, cfg evaluation or activated-feature receipt.
URL parsing/IDNA, file-path conversions, platform helpers, native byte handling and OS behavior have no runtime qualification.
Authenticated source binds branches; numeric/UUID/URL/string grammar, serde format behavior, recursion/budget, duplicate handling and resource behavior have no executable target oracle.
No G01 closure, functional receipt, CVG grant, production/release approval or full third-party security audit.
